## Function that will be used later
```{r, function}
# a function that will get the coefitiant table from the model and 
# pivot the coeficient table into a single row.

pivot_coef_table <- function(model) {
# get the coefisient table from the model and turn it to a data frame
  coef_df <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients$cond)
# add the name "term" which will enable pivot to work
  coef_table <- tibble::rownames_to_column(coef_df, var = "term")
# coefitient table pivot into a single row
coef_table_wide <- coef_table |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -term, names_to = "label", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(name = paste0(term, "_", label))|>
  select(name, value) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = value)

return (coef_table_wide)
}
```

## Test cases

```{r}
#| eval: false

# rows in sim dataset
n <- 500
# size of the re group - number of observations in a random effect group
re_size <- 2
# number of RE groups
n_re <- floor(n/re_size)
# x1 slope
b1 <- 1.5
# x2 slope
b2 <- -0.5
# random intercept standard deviation
group_sd <- 0.5
# residual standard deviation
resid_sd <- 1

sim_data <- data.frame(
    x1 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x2 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x3 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    re_group = gl(n = re_size, k = n_re, length = n),
    resid = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = resid_sd)
  ) |>
    group_by(re_group) |>
    mutate(alpha = rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = group_sd)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(response = 0 + alpha + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 + resid)

  model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + (1 | re_group), data = sim_data)

  coef_wide <- pivot_coef_table(model)
  # coef_wide$row_index <- 1
  # glimpse(coef_wide)
  # summary(model)
  # acf(resid(model))
  
  # this line below is needed in the later work because it defines the colomn names
  coef_wide_names <- names(coef_wide)
```

```{r}
# simulation setting that stays constant

b1 <- 1.5 # x1 slope

b2 <- -0.5 # x2 slope

# residual standard deviation
resid_sd <- 1
```

```{r}
# for loop

for(i in 1:nrow(result)){
  # number of observations in a random effect group
  re_size <- result$re_size[i]
  
  # rows in sim dataset 
  # fluctuate according to how many number of observations are in a re group
  # such that there's consistent number of groups.
  n <- 100 * re_size
  
  # number of RE groups
  n_re <- floor(n/re_size)
  
  sim_data <- data.frame(
    
    x1 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x2 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x3 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    
    # I think the next line has problems, but I don't know how to change it.
    
    re_group = gl(n = n_re, k = re_size, length = n),
    
    resid = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = resid_sd)
  ) |>
    group_by(re_group) |>
    mutate(alpha = rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = group_sd)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(response = 0 + alpha + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 + resid)
  
  model <- glmmTMB(response  ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + (1 | re_group), data = sim_data)

  acf_out <- acf(resid(model), plot = FALSE)
  
  result$acfs[i] <- acf_out$acf[acf_out$lag == 1]
  
  # apply function to get coeficient table in wide format from model
  coef_wide <- pivot_coef_table(model)
  
  for (col in coef_wide_names) {
    result[[col]][i] <- coef_wide[[col]]
  }
}

```

# Compare models with and without the RE

The work below I haven't been able to revise it. 

```{r}

# simulation setting

n <- 500 # rows in sim dataset

n_re <- 2 # size of RE groups

b1 <- 1.5 # x1 slope

b2 <- -0.5 # x2 slope

# random intercept standard deviation
group_sd <- 0.5

# residual standard deviation
resid_sd <- 1

# Preallocate result
result <- data.frame(acfs = rep(NA, n),
                     b1 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x1 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x1 = rep(NA,n),
                     b2 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x2 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x2 = rep(NA,n),
                     b3 = rep(NA,n),
                     p_x3 = rep(NA,n),
                     se_x3 = rep(NA,n),
                     re = rep(NA, n) # whether it has random effect
                     )


# for loop

for(i in 1:500){
  
# simulate data
  
  sim_data <- data.frame(
    x1 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x2 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    x3 = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1),
    re_group = gl(n = floor(n / 2), k = n_re, length = n),
    resid = rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = resid_sd)
  ) |>
    group_by(re_group) |>
    mutate(alpha = rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = group_sd)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(response = 0 + alpha + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 + resid)

# model
  
    if(i < n/2){
    result$re[i] <- "random effect"
    
    model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + x3 + (1 | re_group), data = sim_data)
    
  } else {
    result$re[i] <- "no random effect"
    
    model <- glmmTMB(response ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = sim_data)
  }
  

  acf_out <- acf(resid(model), plot = FALSE)

  coef_df <- as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients$cond)

  result$b1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Estimate"]

  result$b2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Estimate"]

  result$b3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Estimate"]

  result$p_x1[i] <- coef_df["x1", "Pr(>|z|)"]

  result$p_x2[i] <- coef_df["x2", "Pr(>|z|)"]

  result$p_x3[i] <- coef_df["x3", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  result$se_x1[i] <- coef_df["x1","Std. Error"]
  
  result$se_x2[i] <- coef_df["x2","Std. Error"]
  
  result$se_x3[i] <- coef_df["x3","Std. Error"]

  result$acfs[i] <- acf_out$acf[acf_out$lag == 1]
  
}

glimpse(result)
```
